## Description

Optimizes portfolio weights by performing gradient descent directly on the Riemannian manifold of Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) covariance matrices, respecting non-Euclidean geometry constraints.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional covariance matrix estimation, risk-parity allocation, multi-asset portfolio optimization.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Systematic Multi-Asset Desks.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, risk budget constraints, expected returns.

## Caveats

Requires Riemannian geometry operations (exponential and logarithmic maps) for efficient gradient updates.
